title: Restoring Without Forgetting: Continual Learning Across Image Degradations
abstract: arXiv:2608.23799v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent progress in image restoration has converged on all-in-one architectures that jointly handle multiple degradations within a single network. These methods are effective on static benchmarks but target a closed-world setting that assumes simultaneous access to every target degradation at training time. In practice, degradations are encountered sequentially as field-deployed systems progressively face new environmental conditions, and historical training data is often unavailable due to privacy or storage constraints. Accommodating a new degradation then requires either retraining on the union of all prior data, which is often costly or infeasible, or fine-tuning, which causes catastrophic forgetting. We formulate multi-degradation image restoration as a continual domain-incremental learning problem, in which degradations arrive incrementally and prior data is unavailable. translated_title: 无遗忘恢复：跨图像退化场景的持续学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23799v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：图像恢复领域的最新进展已趋向于全合一架构，即在单一网络中联合处理多种退化类型。这些方法在静态基准上表现有效，但针对的是封闭世界设定，假设训练时可同时访问所有目标退化类型。然而，在实际应用中，退化是顺序出现的，因为现场部署的系统会逐步面临新的环境条件，而历史训练数据常因隐私或存储限制而不可用。适应新退化类型要么需要对所有先前数据的联合集进行重新训练（这通常成本高昂或不可行），要么进行微调（这会导致灾难性遗忘）。我们将多退化图像恢复问题建模为持续域增量学习问题，其中退化类型逐步到达且先前数据不可用。我们提出的“无遗忘恢复”（RwF）框架能够...
tldr: 本文提出RwF框架，将多退化图像恢复视为持续域增量学习问题，在无历史数据条件下顺序适应新退化类型，同时避免灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the RwF framework, which formulates multi-degradation image restoration as a continual domain-incremental learning problem, enabling sequential adaptation to new degradations without historical data while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
